_about: Named reel styles. Say "make this in <style>": Studio is the full build (scripts/make_reel.sh); scripts/make_style.py <base> <minimal|hype> builds a variant from the same cut. Every variant needs its own preview approval before render.

studio.what: The full build: full-screen and glass-card window scenes, panel swaps (proof shot, stat, CTA card), back text, inserts (follow card, your clips), effects and transitions, cover title, line captions.

minimal.what: Strict captions only: full screen throughout, punch captions (1-2 words, bold), punch-in open and zooms allowed, no overlays outside captions (no panels, no back text, no cover title).

hype.what: Trendy: full screen throughout, dynamic two-font captions (white caps in the house sans plus each line's key word in yellow Playfair italic, popping on word by word), zoom punch-ins on key words, back text kept, cover kept.
